audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer gave a cooldown for Dark Procession or Mourning Mist, the two abilities the whole lane is played around.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12 and Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8. Twenty seconds at rank 1 is a long window in which he cannot box you, and that is when your step-ups are free.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now appear in the first-item spike, the mid text, whys[5] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites is never mentioned anywhere in the entry, so his damage and sustain are attributed entirely to ghouls.
audit.why: Last Rites is a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4-second attack reset that deals bonus damage and heals him, and it digs the grave that produces more Mist Walkers. It is both his burst tell and his lane sustain — leaving it out makes his trading pattern unreadable.
audit.corrected: Last Rites added to the late-game spike as the healing attack reset that outlasts your burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer instructs 'Shroud out' of the cage, and mid says Shroud works because it 'breaks vision'.
audit.why: Dark Procession summons a DESTRUCTIBLE wall — the answers are attacking it down or dashing over it, not vanishing, because Twilight Shroud does not move you and the wall is still there when the smoke ends. What the shroud genuinely does is make you unselectable, so Mist Walkers and the Maiden lose their attack target.
audit.corrected: Cage lines now say break it or dash out; shroud lines now claim only what unselectability actually gives you.

edits.before: Yorick throws E (Mourning Mist) to slow and mark you, sending his ghouls and autos to free-hit while you only have Q and no Shroud to break vision and reset the trade.
edits.after: Yorick throws E (Mourning Mist) to slow, shred armour and mark you — his ghouls sprint at marked targets — while you have only Q and no Shroud to break the trade.

edits.before: Rocketbelt/Lich Bane with R up is your all-in peak — dodge his E mark, Shroud to drop ghoul and Maiden targeting, then chunk him before he walls you with W.
edits.after: Rocketbelt/Lich Bane with R up is your all-in peak — dodge the E mark, Shroud so ghouls lose you, then chunk him before Dark Procession, 20s at rank 1, boxes you in.

edits.before: With Maiden raised and 2+ items Yorick out-splits and out-sustains you — his ghoul swarm and Maiden chip out-DPS your single-target burst and you can't 1v1 his side lane.
edits.after: With Maiden raised and 2+ items Yorick out-splits and out-sustains you — the ghoul swarm plus Last Rites' healing attack reset out-DPS your burst, and you can't 1v1 his side lane.

edits.before: Drop Shroud to drop his ghouls' and Maiden's targeting and reset the trade, then all-in when his E and W are down
edits.after: Drop Shroud so ghouls and Maiden lose their target, then all-in while Mourning Mist and Dark Procession are down

edits.before: Wall you against terrain with W (Dark Procession) so you can't dash out while the ghoul swarm piles on
edits.after: Box you in with W (Dark Procession) — break the wall or dash out, because sitting there feeds the ghoul swarm

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Yorick's. With only Q and no Shroud you can't reset trades or drop his targeting, so his E (Mourning Mist) marks and slows you while ghouls and autos pile on for free. Don't walk up to throw Q into a marked window — he'll E you and let the swarm chase you down, and his W can wall you against the lane edge if you overstay. Last-hit at max Q range, sidestep the E pool, and respect that his ghouls win the stat-check while you're this naked.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Yorick's. With only Q and no Shroud you can't reset trades or drop his targeting, so his E (Mourning Mist) marks, slows and armour-shreds you while ghouls and autos pile on for free. Don't walk up to throw Q into a marked window — he'll E you and the swarm chases, and his W is a destructible wall he can drop against the lane edge if you overstay. Last-hit at max Q range, sidestep the mist, and respect that his ghouls win the stat-check while you're this naked.

edits.before: His ghouls and W wall punish every step-up while you still lack Shroud to break vision and escape after the E mark lands.
edits.after: His ghouls and the Dark Procession wall punish every step-up while you still lack Shroud to reset after the E mark lands.

edits.before: His E mark, W wall, and stacking ghouls let him punish your all-in if the burst doesn't connect, and his sustain out-trades you past the first window.
edits.after: His E mark, a 20s destructible wall and stacking ghouls punish your all-in if the burst misses, and Last Rites heals him past that window.

edits.before: Shroud his cage — Q-poke him off Maiden. Akali wins the Dark Procession cooldown windows.
edits.after: Break his cage, don't sit in it — Q-poke him off Maiden. Akali wins the wall windows.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for ghouls. Shroud out. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yorick Dark Procession, 20s at rank 1: matchup-defining — a DESTRUCTIBLE wall, so break it or E out; smoke alone does not move you. - Mourning Mist, 12s: it marks you for the ghouls. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Shroud out. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A destructible wall — break it or E out; smoke alone won't move you.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even out once Shroud is online — drop it to make his ghouls and Maiden lose their target and reset, since Shroud breaks vision and targeting (it won't cleanse the E slow itself). Level 6 is your real window: dodge the E mark, E-dash onto Yorick, and Perfect Execution to finish him on low HP — ideally before Maiden is raised and the ghoul count is full. Kill him clean and fast; if the swarm is stacked and Maiden is up, your single-target burst won't out-pace their chip and his sustain.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out once Shroud is online — inside it you cannot be selected, so ghouls and Maiden lose their target and the trade resets (it will not cleanse the E slow already on you). Level 6 is your real window: dodge the E mark, E-dash onto Yorick, and Perfect Execution to finish him on low HP — ideally before Maiden is raised and the ghoul count is full. If he drops Dark Procession, break the wall or dash it: smoke does not move you, and the box stays up for its full duration.

notes: The full layer told you to 'Shroud out' of Dark Procession; Twilight Shroud does not reposition you and the wall persists, so the real answers are attacking it down or dashing over it. Shroud's genuine contribution here is unselectability, which makes Mist Walkers and the Maiden drop their target — I kept that and cut the 'breaks vision' justification. Last Rites (6s attack reset, heals him, digs the grave that spawns more Walkers) was missing from the entry entirely.
